verdict_text: NO. The `matrix_re` pattern omits `gpt_neox.layers.<i>.attention.dense.weight`, so only 3 of the 4 projection matrices per layer (48 tensors) are cast to bfloat16 and the 16 `attention.dense.weight` matrices are left float32 — a violation of Required result clause 1 ("cast exactly the 64 projection matrices ... to bfloat16"). The guard is written as `== 48` rather than `== 64`, so the required check "exactly 64 tensors are bfloat16" is not enforced and the script completes silently with a wrong checkpoint. The other aspects (buffer deletion, 196-tensor count, unchanged names, float32 upcast of everything else, sharded output with the 256 MiB budget) match the specification.
expected_defect: One projection family is missing from the bfloat16 cast pattern (the attention output projection stays float32); the artifact's own count check was adjusted to the wrong number.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm). verdict none = no answer, excluded from rates.
